title: Terms & Conditions
intro: These terms describe the rules for using MatchMate. By using the app, you agree to follow these terms and our community safety standards.

use.title: Use of MatchMate
use.body: You agree to provide accurate profile information, use the service respectfully, and avoid impersonation, harassment, spam, or unlawful activity.

profiles.title: Profiles and Matches
profiles.body: Match suggestions, compatibility scores, and recommendations are informational. You are responsible for evaluating and communicating with other members safely.

payments.title: Subscriptions and Payments
payments.body: Paid features are governed by the plan terms shown at purchase. Taxes, renewals, cancellations, and refunds follow the applicable app store or payment provider rules.

account.title: Account Actions
account.body: You may deactivate or request deletion from Account Settings. Some records may be retained where required for security, legal, fraud prevention, or payment compliance.

safety.title: Safety
safety.body: Do not share sensitive financial information with other members. Report suspicious behaviour and use blocking tools when needed.
